*A whispered accusation rides the fading spell back toward the one who shaped it.*

details.flavorMarkdown: *A preserved undead scholar with ink-blackened bones, ancient robes and books maintained with obsessive care. Centuries of unfinished research have worn away concern for the living.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Unwritten memory

*For a moment, the victim remembers a pain that has not happened yet.*

**Target:** One visible creature within 8 squares. **Player defense:** Reason. **Damage type:** mental.

**Weak defense:** Dazed 2. **Standard defense:** Dazed 1.

**Spell:** Provokes when cast beside an enemy.

### Spell Screen

Before one spell against it resolves, impose 1 Bane on that player attack (or give its controller 1 defense Boon). For one player AoE roll, include this when choosing worst-case modifiers. Does not cancel the spell.

This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. Frightened applies only while this creature is perceptible; the spell is not canceled.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Lifeless Body:** does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

**Healing:** Healing-harmed: ordinary healing resolves as Life damage instead; no beneficial riders.

**Against offensive healing:** controller defends with Fortitude if this is player-controlled; a player attacking it still rolls only their attack.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Fresh annotations appear in books sealed centuries ago.

**Purpose:** Finish one impossible piece of research, whatever the living must pay.

**Tactics and retreat:** Disrupt approaching heroes with Mind Hammer and protect itself with Spell Screen; bargain for a missing text.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Remove its research from the chamber or offer knowledge it cannot take by force.

**Habitat:** Sealed library; tomb · **Communication:** Common and ancient scholarly languages

**Loot:** Research, a named recipe chosen by the DA, and 150 coins; no automatic resurrection anchor.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-tomb-sage


**Category:** Undead · **Role:** Arcane villain · **CV:** 50

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unwritten memory | Knowledge | 1 Boon | 4 mental damage. | 6 mental damage. Dazed 1. | 8 mental damage. Dazed 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 4/6/8

**Reference type:** mental

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.65

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.5 → 1.65: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=2.404, O=6.596. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md), [mind hammer](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/mind-hammer.md), [Reproach the Caster](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/reproach-the-caster.md), [spell screen](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/spell-screen.md), [Study the Opening](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/watch-the-opening.md).

# Lifeless Body

*Nothing breathes beneath the torn coat; nothing living looks through the visor.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-lifeless-body


**Action:** Passive

The card must list its exact condition immunities; this trait grants no additional unlisted ones. It does not breathe or need food. Undead entries marked healing-harmed take a healing result as Life damage; constructs marked repair-only do not regain HP from ordinary healing. Neither rule prevents physical attacks from dealing their normal minimum damage.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

monsterAbilityTemplates.flavorMarkdown: *A sharp gesture splinters the incoming light into a cloud of harmless sparks.*
monsterAbilityTemplates.rulesMarkdown:
Before one spell attack against this creature resolves, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll (or grant 1 defense Boon to its player controller). The protection belongs to this creature. For a player’s single AoE attack roll, include it when finding the worst target modifiers, as normal; do not make a separate roll or rescore outcomes for other targets. If players defend separately against an NPC area, it benefits only its own recipient. This is defensive interference, not cancellation; the resulting spell outcome still resolves.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
